title: Improvement of Quality of Life (QoL) Using Preference-Oriented QoLMonitoring in Patients with Lung Cancer
official: Improvement of Quality of Life (QoL) Using Preference-Oriented QoLMonitoring and Linkage with Clinical Registry Data: Randomised Clinical Trial in Patients with Lung Cancer
summary: The purpose of the study is to determine whether a preference-oriented quality of life monitoring with defined diagnostic and therapeutic options improves quality of life in patients with lung cancer during routine follow-up care.
